source: Measured: the image-only scripted oracle (solution/policy.py) reached all six delivery points on every scene of the hidden set (24 of 24, delivered_fraction 1.0 each), run once per scene through the robot service and the grader's ledger replay by the pre-registered selection (tests/review/hidden_set/RULE.md, selection.jsonl). Every kept episode scored exactly what its selection run scored, so full_at is 0.98.
